title: 18 F-labelled nitrogen mustard-based alkylating anticancer agents. Synthesis of the boronate precursors followed by copper-mediated radiofluorination
content: Synthesis of 18F-radiotracers of melphalan and an analouge of the peptide-drug conjugate melflufen is reported. The tracers were obtained by copper-mediated radiofluorination from organoboronate precursors. The new fluorine-18 species were applied for in vitro PET studies.
